findings.title: Repair references the current injection file SHA instead of the frozen pending SHA
findings.detail: pending_fault.injection_sha256 is stored at line289, but repair acceptance compares its declaration only with FileAccess.get_sha256(injection_path) at line295. Replacing injection.json after pending and supplying that new SHA can pass while the original pending evidence points to a different file. The asserted exact-original-fault repair binding is therefore not enforced.
findings.required_fix: Parse injection from the same first raw UTF8 bytes used for SHA, verify the current file remains that SHA, preserve the first pin in pending_fault, and require both current injection bytes and repair declaration to equal that original pending SHA. Future controller must retain its first raw pin too.

qualification_note: Rejected source-only preliminary candidate, no native/controller admission. Only the indicated custody defect requires successor source change; other reviewed source/API conclusions can be reused for its precise diff. Future debugger must bind exact source/stack/current coordinator and owned candidate/public path, skip unrelated prefs calls, and have a narrow expected-diagnostic runtime before any execution. No old A or prior lifecycle qualification is transferred.
